core_obligations: Base case: essentialness makes the maximal-ideal torsion of the injective hull equal to the residue field, so the formula holds for the residue field (proof lines 922-926)

Induction: for a nonzero module of finite length there is a surjection onto the residue field with kernel of smaller length, and exactness of the Hom functor into the injective hull gives a short exact sequence whose lengths are additive (proof lines 927-936)
The final statement follows by evaluating at the ring itself (proof lines 937-938)
proof_roadmap: E 是 κ 的本质扩张 ⇒ E[m] = κ ⇒ Hom_R(κ, E) ≅ κ，κ 情形成立。
对 M 的长度作归纳：取满射 M → κ、核 M'；由 Hom(-, E) 的正合性得短正合列，长度可加 ⇒ 归纳步成立。
末句取 M = R：E = Hom_R(R, E)。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives the length formula for the module of maps into an injective hull of the residue field over a complete local ring (author lemma at source lines 911-920, label lemma-finite). The proof (source lines 922-939) settles the residue field by essentialness and inducts on the length using exactness of the Hom functor into the injective hull, with the final assertion from evaluating at the ring (proof lines 922-938). The induction step is the substance. H3.
